summary: Both commits are clean. The backend validateSteps boolean split is correct: update()→content=false runs structural/security/DoS + FORMAT-IF-PRESENT injection guards only; activate() and testRun()→content=true add full content-completeness including broken-edge checks, which remain activate-only. No double-validation, no path that skips structural checks. The frontend stepReady/persistSteps gate is fully removed; all five canvas handlers (onCanvasSteps, onCanvasTriggers, onCanvasNotes, onNodeDragStop, onCanvasStepSave) call persist() unconditionally. The trigger-watch debounce gate (triggerReady) is kept but is step-agnostic — it guards only against mid-keystroke trigger flushes. The user's exact bug (delete start node while incomplete ADD_TAG exists silently withheld) is fixed: onCanvasTriggers calls persist() directly with no step-readiness check. stepSaveFeedback and its i18n key are removed cleanly from both locale files with no leftover usage in pages/components/tests. Residual mentions in a FunnelCanvas comment are historical-context prose, not live references. Test coverage at both layers covers the new contract including the exact regression scenario.
